notes.title: DOLLS THE HUNT — First trailer & new development updates!
notes.content: [h3][b]Watch the first trailer of DOLLS THE HUNT![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="guFy9--dqOg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Development Updates[/h3][p]Hello survivors! The development of [i]DOLLS: THE HUNT[/i] took longer than expected, but it comes with exciting news: more game modes, skins, and challenges to deliver the best experience possible.[/p][p]The game will feature 3 game modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hunt Mode[/b]: The classic battle where 1 player is the Hunter and the others are the Prey. Best enjoyed with a full lobby![/p][/*][*][p][b]Deathmatch Mode[/b]: You and your friends fight until only one survives.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escape Mode[/b]: Play solo or in a group as you try to escape from monsters, labyrinths, and solve puzzles to survive.[/p][/*][/list][p]Another big update: apart from Hunt Mode, the game will support both first-person and third-person perspectives, giving players more ways to experience the hunt.[/p][p][/p][h3]Play with your friends![/h3][list][*][p]Private matches with friends or global public lobbies with up to 5 players.[/p][/*][*][p]Switch between first-person or third-person gameplay (except in Hunt Mode).[/p][/*][*][p]Create public or private lobbies to challenge players worldwide.[/p][/*][*][p]Communicate with others through voice and text chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Explore richly detailed environments while trying to survive.[/p][/*][*][p]Have fun and interact in tense, strategy-filled matches.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Support the Dolls series![/h3][p]To support the project, add it to your wishlist! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065180/Dolls_The_Hunt/"][/dynamiclink]Stay tuned for more updates coming soon![/p]
